clouds-gpt.png.prompt: Edit the approved QQ 2008 interface reference into a reusable BACKGROUND TEXTURE asset only for the same UI. Extract/repaint its beautiful sky-blue glossy header art: the pale wispy white clouds, translucent sweeping cyan curved bands, faint world globe/map motif, silver-white top shine. Render ONE continuous ultrawide horizontal strip, approximately 8:1 aspect ratio, 1536x192 or similar. Edge to edge sky blue artwork, no exterior background, no frame. Very restrained/clouds sparse so dark small UI text laid over it remains readable. A small faint world globe near the upper-middle, sweeping translucent blue waves and tiny cloud wisps to the right, calmer light blue left half. Match the exact 2008 QQ sky-blue color and non-flat glossy glass material of the reference. DELETE ALL text, letters, numerals, QQ logo, penguins, avatars, icons, buttons, UI panels, dividers, controls. This must be a clean usable raster strip, not a new full interface, not a screenshot or presentation. No labels. We will resize the strip to native 480px width for title/profile headers.

icons-gpt.png.prompt: Using the approved QQ 2008 UI image as a STRICT material and aesthetic reference, make a reusable transparent sprite sheet of EIGHT different small toolbar icons. This is asset extraction/redesign for a real small-screen QQ2008 port, not a new UI screenshot. Layout EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells across the full canvas, transparent background, each icon centered in its own equal cell with generous clear margin; every icon occupies about 65% of cell width and height. Prefer canvas 1024x512. No text or labels, no grid lines, no surrounding tiles or button rectangles, no background decoration. Icons rendered as colorful mildly glossy 2008 Windows/QQ skeuomorphic raster art with clean crisp silhouette and slight silver highlights, legible when reduced to 16x16 or 20x20 pixels. Match reference's beautiful blue group and clock icons. EXACT order: top row column1 two blue people (group); column2 silver round clock face with blue hands (recent chats); column3 silver-blue magnifying glass (search); column4 circular curved blue refresh arrow (refresh). Bottom row column1 yellow wooden pencil with red eraser angled diagonally (compose/edit); column2 green circular glossy badge with a white check (connected session status, not claim of per-friend online presence); column3 small silver-blue gear (menu); column4 small white envelope with blue outline (message). Keep all eight separate and fully within their equal cells. No giant shadows, no cutoffs, no multiple icons in a cell, no fake transparency checkerboard, alpha must be transparent.
